title: Stimulation model: does optogenetic perturbation change coupling (kappa)?
question: Does closed-loop optogenetic stimulation change Purkinje-cell coupling (scalar kappa in the pulse window), or only firing rates?
headline: Inconclusive (outcome c). Raw kappa_pulse - kappa_control: HL -0.27, 90% CI -0.47 to -0.02, Wilcoxon p=0.065, FDR 0.13, not equivalent to 0 within +-0.3 (n=21). No change in multi-information (p=0.79). Lean toward a decrease depends on control window and cohort. Run 1 (bins 0-699) retracted; this is the refit under amendments A3-A5.
